author: Inside Edition
description: He's only 14 and a high school freshman, but Dean Roy says he's wanted to get into the governor's office since middle school, which he only left last year. Roy will be the youngest person to ever be on the ballot for the state's governor. He says he is taking advantage of a state law that doesn't set an age limit for candidates. It just has a 4-year residency requirement. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: High School Freshman, 14, Will Be Youngest Candidate For Vermont Governor

author: Inside Edition
description: Arnold Schwarzenegger was in the gym with his son Joseph Baena showing the 28-year-old how to show off his physique in preparation for Baena's very first bodybuilding competition. Baena's poses mimic the same poses that his father did decades earlier. Schwarzenegger famously won five Mr. Universe titles and seven Mr. Olympia titles. Now, he hopes to lead his son to victory in Saturday's Natural Colorado State Championship.
title: Arnold Schwarzenegger Trains Son For First Bodybuilding Competition

author: Inside Edition
description: John F. Kennedy Jr. and Carolyn Bessette's fatal flight was depicted in Thursday night's series finale of "Love Story." On July 16, 1999, the couple and Bessette's older sister, Lauren, were on their way to Martha's Vineyard for a wedding, but an hour after taking off, the plane crashed into the Atlantic Ocean, killing all of them. Aviation analyst Kyle Bailey was the last person to see JFK Jr. and Carolyn Bessette alive. He spoke with Inside Edition's Alison Hall.
title: Last Person To See JFK Jr. And Carolyn Bessette Alive Speaks Out

author: Inside Edition
description: Mother Amberlee Collazo is speaking out after her 12-year-old son was allegedly kidnapped by another mom. Police allege that Shannon Tufuga made Collazo's son Kristopher get into her vehicle, drove him to the home and told him to apologize to her child for bullying her at school. Tufuga then drove Kristopher home, according to authorities. Tufuga is charged with kidnapping and aggravated child abuse. She denies all the allegations. Kristopher denies bullying her child.
title: Mom Of Child Allegedly Kidnapped By Another Mom Speaks Out

author: Inside Edition
description: Savannah Guthrie is returning to the "Today" show on April 6 for the first time since the kidnapping of her 84-year-old mother. Guthrie told Hoda Kotb her return is an act of defiance aimed directly at the kidnappers. She said she was inspired by her emotional visit to the "Today" studio three weeks ago when she was surrounded by support from her colleagues. Guthrie renewed her appeal for information that may solve the baffling mystery that is transfixing the nation.
title: Savannah Guthrie To Return To The 'Today' Show On April 6

author: Inside Edition
description: In a harrowing ocean rescue in Florida, a boater was pulled to safety. But he was not the only one who needed saving. Multiple boaters were scattered after their pontoon boat overturned. Marine unit deputies and good Samaritans plucked the distressed boaters from the rough waters. In Colorado, a skier was about to encounter a frightening moment as he flew off a jump and nearly crashed into a child. Skier Dave Sugnet made a last minute move, narrowly avoiding the boy's head.
title: Videos Show Harrowing Water Rescue In Florida, Skier Nearly Misses Kid

author: Inside Edition
description: A Florida man was arrested behind the gate of an airport. How he got there, well, he says he's not too sure. The Volusia County Sheriff's Office says Bryan Parker, 58, crashed a car through a gate at Daytona International Airport. They say he was found intoxicated, but was able to tell deputies his assessment of what had happened to lead him there. In a bodycam video, he said he remembered doing drugs after attending an AA meeting. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Florida Man Arrested After Crashing Car Through Airport Gate: Cops

author: Inside Edition
description: Savannah Guthrie says she is wracked with guilt over the thought that her fame triggered her mother Nancy Guthrie's abduction.
title: Savannah Guthrie Fears Her Fame Led To Mother's Kidnapping #shorts

author: Inside Edition
description: Two Maryland State Troopers are being hailed as heroes for saving a choking baby during a called on March 21. The swift actions of Trooper Taylor Hersh and Corporal Jonathan Soultzfus from MDSP's Prince Frederick Barrack, saved the child after one of the troopers grabs the baby from the mother's hands and gave it the Heimlich maneuver and within seconds the baby boy can be seen moving and breathing. It is unknown what caused the baby to choke, but the bodycam footage of the rescue was put on social media by the Maryland State Police.
title: Bodycam Captures 2 Maryland State Police Saving Choking Infant

author: Inside Edition
description: They're the smallest victims of the war in Iran. Since the US and Israel launched attacks on the country nearly a month ago, many people have fled the danger. When leaving Iran via the nation of Oman, some expats had to make tough decisions about who comes with them. Rescue centers in Muscat say they are helping some pets get to their families who have fled, but many of them are being left behind and these shelters are filling up fast. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Abandoned Animals Fill Up Rescue Shelters As People Flee Iran War

author: Inside Edition
description: A third-grader made her talent show debut dancing to the Alicia Keys hit "This Girl is on Fire." Suddenly, the music stopped due to a technical malfunction and 8-year-old Emberly Lau was not sure what to do. A voice rang out from the audience and it was Emberly's elementary school teacher. She gave the young student confidence to finish the dance, even if she had to make up some of the lyrics. Emberly and teacher Kurstin Frank spoke with Inside Edition.
title: Teacher Comes To Rescue After Student's Music Cuts Out During Show
